title: Read-only reviewer Git guard refuses read-only `git branch --list <pattern>` and `git worktree list`
outcome: In a read-only (reviewer) Claude delegation, `git branch -a --list <pattern>` and `git worktree list` are accepted as read-only. They only list and change nothing, while the guard keeps refusing branch creation, deletion and renaming and worktree add/remove/prune.
acceptance: In a read-only Claude delegation, `git branch --list <pattern>` (with or without -a or -r) and `git worktree list` run without refusal, shown by a test of the guard's classification.
Branch-mutating forms (a branch name argument without --list, -d, -D, -m, -M, -c, -C) and `git worktree add|remove|prune|move|lock|unlock` stay refused, shown by the same test.
